items.name: YOU TIAO
items.description: One of Dough Culture's Four Heavenly Kings, this traditional snack features golden brown dough strips, perfect for coffee, soy bean milk or porridge!

items.name: 2 IN 1 SWEET CAKE
items.description: Perfect for sweet tooth lovers, a crispy snack of nian gao and sweet potato!

items.name: 3 IN 1 SWEETCAKE
items.description: A sweet snack with crispy exterior and soft interior, featuring layers of yam, nian gao and sweet potato.

items.name: BANANA BALLS (5 PCS)
items.description: Golden and crispy sweet banana balls for all, especially the kids.

items.name: BANANA FRITTER
items.description: Natural sweet banana coated with a light crispy batter, always a favourite!

items.name: BUTTERFLY BUN
items.description: One of Dough Culture's Four Heavenly Kings, a chewy dough snack which resembles the shape of butterfly, is coated with sesame seeds for the extra fragrance.

items.name: CARROT CAKE
items.description: Dough Culture's classic favourite. Blended sweet radish steamed, then deep fried to golden brown.

items.name: CURRY PUFF
items.description: A semi-circle thin pastry pie filled with fragrant curry potato cubes.

items.name: GREEN BEAN CAKE
items.description: Delicious and fried to perfection, it is filled with mashed green beans.

items.name: PEANUT SESAME BALL
items.description: Filled with nutty coarse grounded peanut and fried to a perfect crisp and chew.

items.name: RED BEAN BUN
items.description: Craving for something sweet? Featuring one of Dough Culture's Four Heavenly Kings, another round dough filled with red bean, also commonly known as the Sweet Ham Chim Peng.

items.name: SALTED BUN
items.description: One of Dough Culture's Four Heavenly Kings, also known as Ham Chim Peng, this round dough snack features a swirl pattern of five spices, giving this bun a salty and fragrant taste to each bite.

items.name: SAMOSA (3 PCS)
items.description: Little triangular crisps filled with curry mashed potato, suitable for all ages!

items.name: SPRING ROLL (VEG)
items.description: Generous amount of well-seasoned turnip wrapped in crispy popiah skin.

items.name: SWEET POTATO SLICE
items.description: An evenly sliced sweet potato is coated with a light batter and every mouthful is sweet!

items.name: TAPIOCA CAKE
items.description: The soft and chewy tapioca cake is encased in a light, crispy crust, with a hint of pandan fragrance.

items.name: VEGGIE BALLS (5 PCS)
items.description: Coated with a thin batter, the cabbage and carrot are fried to a perfect golden crisp.

items.name: YAM CAKE
items.description: Our signature yam cake is packed with fresh blended yam and goodness.

items.name: YELLOW BEAN SESAME BALL
items.description: Rolled in fragrant sesame seeds with mung bean filling, this chewy ball is definitely an enjoyment!

items.name: YOU TIAO ROJAK
items.description: Dough Culture's most popular snack; crispy chewy you tiao slices doused in generous amount of vegetarian rojak sauce and nutty peanuts.

items.name: VEGE PORRIDGE
items.description: Another favourite among our regulars! A perfectly cooked porridge paired with braised peanuts, mock fish cake slices and you tiao bites!

items.name: TAU SUAN
items.description: One of our best sellers! Thick mung bean paste paired with crispy golden you tiao slices, a perfect combination of textures!

items.name: CRISPY SOYA SKIN
items.description: Indulge in the satisfying crunch that envelops each piece of soya skin, the result of expert frying that brings out its inherent crispiness.

items.name: CRISPY SOYA SKIN  (2 BOXES)
items.description: Indulge in the satisfying crunch that envelops each piece of soya skin, the result of expert frying that brings out its inherent crispiness.

items.name: SOYA MILK
items.description: A nourishing and versatile beverage that stems from the essence of soybeans.
